details.baseline_assertion_reason: The pristine upstream runtime.cc run_select_case predicate uses Returns[1] + 1 on the sentinel pointer. The existing calculator patch compares uintptr_t(Returns[1]) with uintptr_t(-1), avoiding that pointer arithmetic. Only that predicate and its recorder backtrace echoes appear in the pristine baseline. The patched suite has zero assertions.
